name: Security Characteristics 3
definition: Set of elements used to provide detailed information about the security.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification, as known by the account owner, to unambiguously identify the security.

Position.name: Position
Position.definition: Specifies the position for the security.

ValuationPrice.name: Valuation Price
ValuationPrice.definition: Specifies the price of the security for valuation purposes.

CollateralValue.name: Collateral Value
CollateralValue.definition: Specifies the value of the security for collateral purposes.
